description: This file defines an immutable configuration class for JavaScript message mappers within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements the JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration interface, providing getter methods for configuration properties, incoming and outgoing conditions, and overrides equality, hash, and string representation methods. It also contains a builder class for constructing instances of the configuration in a thread-unsafe manner.

classes.name: ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the JavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration interface, encapsulating message mapper configurations with thread-safe guarantees.

classes.name: ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration.Builder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration instances. It is annotated as NotThreadSafe and provides getter methods for the configuration properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the message mapper configuration.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the properties map associated with the message mapper configuration.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of incoming message conditions.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Returns the map of outgoing message conditions.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare configuration instances based on their delegation target.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on the delegation target.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs a new ImmutableJavaScriptMessageMapperConfiguration instance based on the builder's data.
